plans.idea: A three-column banner that reads left to right: the bottle with its NEW badge on the left, logo, a one-line headline and the legal line in the middle, and a large CTA on the right, so the badge, legal text and sticker are no longer crammed together along the bottom.

A left-aligned editorial stack: a large logo anchors the far left, then the headline sits over the CTA on one shared left edge, and the bottle with its NEW badge closes the banner on the right as the visual payoff.

The message comes first and the product sits in the centre: logo over the headline on the left, the bottle with its NEW badge in the middle, and the CTA on the right, so the eye goes from brand to message to product to action.
